info.title: Gannet JSON-RPC API
info.description: Gannet is an API for booking flights, hotels, and more. Uses JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol.

methods.name: token:create
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a JWT token for subsequent API calls.

params.name: profile
params.description: Optional per-agent settings for flight methods, stored in the token. Each entry's `policy` (and optional `policyFlight`) determines the agent fee and platform fee fields added to flight prices in responses made with this token. The agent codes listed here are also used to activate any additional agents configured for the account.

params.name: profileHotel
params.description: Optional per-agent settings for hotel methods, stored in the token. Each entry's `policy` determines the agent fee and platform fee fields added to hotel room prices in responses made with this token. `policyFlight` is not used here.

methods.name: flight:schedule:list
methods.description: Returns available flight schedules with fare information for the specified route, date, and passenger count.

params.name: carriers
params.description: Optional list of airline carrier codes to search (e.g., ['QG', 'GA']). When omitted or empty, all carriers available to your agents are searched.

params.name: schedules
params.description: List of route searches (origin, destination, dates)

methods.name: flight:schedule:fare
methods.summary: Get detailed fare breakdown for selected flights
methods.description: Returns detailed fare information including tax breakdown for the selected flight schedule and fare class.

methods.name: flight:book
methods.description: Creates a flight booking (PNR) with passenger details for the selected schedule and fare.

params.name: info
params.description: Booking information including contact and passenger details

methods.name: flight:sync
methods.description: Retrieves the current status and details of an existing flight booking. Only bookings whose current status is BOOKED can be synced: syncing a booking that has already been issued (TICKETED) or cancelled returns an ERROR result ("Booking Status of PNR restricted to sync"). In the sync response each passenger's `paxID` is derived from the passenger type and names as stored by the airline (e.g. 'ADTJOHNDOE'), not the `paxID` sent in `flight:book`. The synced PNR replaces the stored one, so later `flight:issue` responses use these derived `paxID` values. Ticket numbers are not returned by this method.

methods.name: flight:issue
methods.description: Issues tickets for an existing flight booking. Converts a booked PNR to issued tickets. Only bookings with status BOOKED can be issued. On success the returned PNR has `bookingStatus` TICKETED and carries the ticket numbers in `info.ticketNumbers` (see PaxTicketNumbers). This is the only method that returns ticket numbers; the booking cannot be synced afterwards.

methods.name: flight:cancel
methods.description: Cancels an existing flight booking. Only booked (not issued) bookings can be cancelled. On success the cancelled PNR is returned with `bookingStatus` CANCELLED, or CANCELDELAYED when the supplier has accepted the cancellation but will complete it later.

methods.name: hotel:destinations:list
methods.description: Returns a list of hotel destinations matching the search term.

methods.name: hotel:searchby:destination
methods.description: Returns available hotels for a destination with room count and dates. Adults, children and infants are given as totals and spread across `totalRooms`. When a total is a multiple of `totalRooms` it is split evenly; otherwise the per-room counts are rounded up, so the occupancy searched can be larger than the requested total (e.g. 3 adults in 2 rooms are searched as 2 + 2, and 1 child in 2 rooms as 1 + 1). Children can instead be placed per room with `childrenAges`. The resulting per-room occupancy is carried in `searchKeyData` and reused by `hotel:fetch:rooms`.

params.name: totalAdults
params.description: Total number of adult guests, spread across the rooms

params.name: totalChilds
params.description: Total number of child guests, spread across the rooms. Ignored when `childrenAges` is not empty (the per-room child counts then come from `childrenAges`).

params.name: totalInfants
params.description: Total number of infant guests, spread across the rooms. Defaults to 0.

params.name: childrenAges
params.description: Children ages PER ROOM: one array per room (length = totalRooms), each holding the ages of the children in that room; use [] for a room without children, e.g. [[5, 8], []] for 2 rooms. When not empty, the number of children in each room is the length of its array. A flat array such as [5, 8] is not accepted. When omitted or empty, `totalChilds` is spread across the rooms and every child's age is taken as 8.

methods.name: hotel:fetch:detail
methods.description: Returns detailed information about a hotel including facilities, amenities, and photos.

methods.name: hotel:fetch:rooms
methods.summary: Get available rooms for a hotel
methods.description: Returns available rooms with pricing and cancellation policies for a specific hotel.

params.name: agentCodes
params.description: List of agent codes to get pricing for

methods.name: hotel:room:checkprice
methods.description: Verifies current pricing for selected rooms before booking.

params.name: roomSelectedData
params.description: Selected room data for price check

methods.name: hotel:book
methods.description: Creates a hotel booking with guest details for the selected rooms.

params.name: clientReference
params.description: Client reference for the booking. Must be present: a request without `clientReference` returns an ERROR result.

params.name: doIssueImmediately
params.description: Optional. When `true`, the supplier is asked to issue (voucher) the booking as part of this request, instead of leaving it for a separate `hotel:issue` call. Check `vendorInformation.voucherStatus` in the response. Any other value, or omitting it, only books.

methods.name: hotel:fetch:booking
methods.description: Retrieves the details of an existing hotel booking.

methods.name: hotel:issue
methods.description: Issues a voucher for an existing hotel booking, confirming the reservation.

methods.name: hotel:cancel
methods.description: Cancels an existing hotel booking. Cancellation charges may apply based on policy.

ResultTime.description: Timing information for the API request/response

Result.description: Standard result object included in all API responses

errors.description: List of error messages (present when status is ERROR)

AgentProfile.description: Per-agent settings passed to token:create in `profile` (flight) or `profileHotel` (hotel)

AgentPricingPolicy.description: Pricing policy of one agent. Values may be numbers or numeric strings. Without `markupPercent` the policy is not applied (for flights, unless a `policyFlight` entry matches), so send `markupPercent` even when there is no markup (use 0). Give `platformFee` and `discountCBD` as well (use 0 when not applicable).

markupPercent.description: Agent markup in percent (e.g. 4 = 4%), returned as agentServiceFee / agentIssuedFee and included in agentSellingFare

platformFee.description: Platform fee in percent (e.g. 2 = 2%). Returned as the fraction `platformFee` (0.02) and the amount `platformFeeAmount`, which is included in `TOPSellingFare`

discountCBD.description: CBD discount in percent. Returned as the fraction `discountCBD` and the amount `discountCBDAmount` (informational, not subtracted from `TOPSellingFare`)

FlightPricingPolicy.description: Optional flight markup for specific airlines (`profile` only). For flights whose marketing carrier is listed in `airline`, it replaces `policy.markupPercent`; `policy.platformFee` and `policy.discountCBD` still apply and must be given.

type.description: FIXED: `amount` per passenger. PERCENT: `percent` of the published fare

amount.description: Agent fee per passenger when type is FIXED

percent.description: Agent markup in percent when type is PERCENT

airline.description: Object whose values are lists of marketing carrier codes this policy applies to (the keys are not interpreted), e.g. {"domestic": ["GA", "QG"]}

SupplairCode.description: Supplier air code for flight services (e.g., 'PGS')

OperatingCarrierInfo.description: Operating carrier information with operational suffix

returnDate.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format (null for one-way)

Journey.description: Journey information linking origin to destination through segments

segmentIDS.description: List of segment IDs comprising this journey

Segment.description: Flight segment representing one continuous flight

departureDateTime.description: Departure date and time in ISO 8601 format

arrivalDateTime.description: Arrival date and time in ISO 8601 format

legIDS.description: List of leg IDs within this segment

Leg.description: Flight leg representing takeoff to landing (smallest flight unit)

FreeCheckinBaggage.description: Free check-in baggage information for a specific route

Offer.description: Fare offer for a specific passenger type

platformFee.description: Platform fee rate as a fraction (e.g. 0.02 = 2%), from the token profile

platformFeeAmount.description: Platform fee amount: totalFare x platformFee, rounded

discountCBD.description: CBD discount rate as a fraction (e.g. 0.05 = 5%), from the token profile

discountCBDAmount.description: CBD discount amount: totalFare x discountCBD, rounded. Informational; not subtracted from TOPSellingFare

AgentOffersFare.description: Agent-specific fare offers from a supplier

isSupportNKRI.description: Whether NKRI (domestic Indonesian) pricing is supported

offers.description: List of fare offers per passenger type

Fare.description: Fare class details with availability and pricing

canBuyAdditionalBaggage.description: Whether additional baggage can be purchased

SegmentFare.description: Available fares for a specific segment

Schedule.description: Flight schedule with associated fare information

FlightScheduleInfo.description: Flight schedule information containing journeys, segments, and legs

JourneySegmentFareSelection.description: Journey-level segment fare selection for booking

ScheduleFareDetailRequest.description: Request parameters for getting fare details

FareTax.description: Individual tax component of a fare

FarePrice.description: Complete fare price breakdown with taxes

platformFee.description: Platform fee rate as a fraction (e.g. 0.02 = 2%), from the token profile

platformFeeAmount.description: Platform fee amount: totalPublishFare x platformFee, rounded

discountCBD.description: CBD discount rate as a fraction (e.g. 0.05 = 5%), from the token profile

discountCBDAmount.description: CBD discount amount: totalPublishFare x discountCBD, rounded. Informational; not subtracted from TOPSellingFare

FareComponent.description: Fare component linking fare class to segment

FareDetail.description: Detailed fare information for a passenger

FareSummary.description: Summary totals for all fares in a booking

Passenger.description: Passenger information for flight booking. `dob` and `nationality` are required for CHD and INF passengers

paxID.description: Unique passenger identifier. PNRs returned by `flight:sync`, and by `flight:issue` after a sync, carry a `paxID` derived from the passenger type and names (e.g. 'ADTJOHNDOE') instead of the one sent in `flight:book`

paxRefID.description: For INF passengers in `flight:book`: the `paxID` of the adult the infant travels with

title.description: ADT: MR, MRS or MS. CHD and INF: MSTR or MISS (MR and MRS sent for a child or infant are converted to MSTR and MISS). Any other combination is rejected.

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required for CHD and INF passengers

identityNumber.description: National identity number. Forwarded to the airline only when `nationality` is 'ID'

staffIdentityNumber.description: Staff identity number, forwarded to the airline as a passenger document when not empty

Passport.description: Passport details for a passenger. Forwarded to the airline only when `number` is not empty

expired.description: Passport expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format

FlightBookingInfo.description: Booking information including contact and passengers

BookingSummary.description: Financial summary of a flight booking

platformFeeAmount.description: Sum of scheduleFareDetail[].fareSummary.platformFeeAmount. Present only when greater than 0

discountCBDAmount.description: Sum of scheduleFareDetail[].fareSummary.discountCBDAmount. Present only when greater than 0

TOPSellingFare.description: Sum of scheduleFareDetail[].fareSummary.TOPSellingFare. Present only when greater than 0

BookingStatus.description: Status of a flight booking. Values returned by the server: BOOKED (booked/held, not yet ticketed), TICKETED (tickets issued; returned by a successful flight:issue), CANCELLED (returned by flight:cancel), CANCELDELAYED (returned by flight:cancel when the supplier has accepted the cancellation but will complete it later). Any other status reported by the supplier is passed through unchanged.

FlightPNR.description: Flight PNR (Passenger Name Record) with complete booking details

ticketNumbers.description: Ticket numbers per passenger. Returned only by a successful `flight:issue`

PaxTicketNumbers.description: Ticket numbers of one passenger, returned by `flight:issue` in FlightPNR `info.ticketNumbers`. A passenger for whom the supplier returned no ticket is not listed

paxID.description: `paxID` of the passenger in the stored PNR (`info.paxs[].paxID`): the one sent in `flight:book`, or the derived one (e.g. 'ADTJOHNDOE') if the booking was synced before issuing

SegmentTicketNumber.description: One ticket of a passenger and the segments it covers

ticketNumber.description: Ticket number. May be null when the supplier does not return a ticket number

destinationKey.description: Unique encrypted destination key for hotel search

SearchKeyData.description: Encrypted search key data for subsequent hotel requests

LowestPrice.description: Lowest available price for a hotel

AgentSellingPrice.description: Agent-specific selling price for a hotel

discountCBD.description: CBD discount rate as a fraction (e.g. 0.05 = 5%), from the token profileHotel

discountCBDAmount.description: CBD discount amount. Informational; not subtracted from TOPSellingFare

platformFee.description: Platform fee rate as a fraction (e.g. 0.02 = 2%), from the token profileHotel

platformFeeAmount.description: Platform fee amount: totalPrice x platformFee, rounded

RoomCancellationCharge.description: Cancellation charge for a date range

roomCancellationCharges.description: List of cancellation charges by date

amenities.description: List of amenities in this group

RoomInformation.description: Room information in hotel search/fetch results

roomBoardCode.description: Board code (e.g., 'RO' for Room Only, 'BDBF' for Breakfast)

RoomIndexCombination.description: Room index combination for multi-room bookings

roomIndexSequence.description: Sequence of room indices that can be booked together

RoomCombinationType.description: Type of room combination for booking. The value is passed through unchanged from the hotel supplier, so treat it as an open string. Known values: FixedRoomCombination (the value seen in the examples), FreeRoomCombination, IdenticalRoomCombination, FlexibleRoomCombination.

HotelRoomInformation.description: Hotel room information response from fetch:rooms

RoomIDSelection.description: Room ID selection for booking: one entry per room of the booking

roomID.description: `roomID` from hotel:fetch:rooms. The same roomID may be repeated for several room numbers (e.g. two rooms of the same type)

RoomSelectedData.description: Selected room data for booking/check price

roomIDS.description: One entry per room number, each sent to the supplier as-is (e.g. for 2 rooms: [{roomNumber: 1, roomID: X}, {roomNumber: 2, roomID: X}])

age.description: Optional guest age, forwarded to the supplier when present (e.g. for children)

RoomGuestData.description: Room guest data for hotel booking

SupplierInformation.description: Hotel supplier information in booking response

VendorInformation.description: Hotel vendor information in booking response

HotelBookingRoomInfo.description: Room information in hotel booking response

HotelBookingResponse.description: Hotel booking response (used for book, issue, cancel, fetch:booking)
